name: New Jersey
standard: WCAG 2.1 AA (OIT Web Presence Guidelines / ADA Title II); older contract clause names WCAG 2.0 AA

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web & mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by IFR 2026-07663)
laws.summary: Federal floor: state and local government web content and mobile apps must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA; the April 2026 IFR moved compliance to 2027-04-26 (pop. 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

applies_to: Executive branch agency websites managed under OIT guidelines; local governments via ADA Title II.

deadlines.what: ADA Title II rule: state government and local governments with population 50,000+ must conform web content and mobile apps to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
ADA Title II rule: local governments under 50,000 and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: Sites responsive/mobile-friendly and accessible per Section 508 with WCAG 2.1 AA as technical standard (guidelines)
Vendor must resolve reported accessibility deficiencies for the contract term (clause)
mobile: implied — Web Presence Guidelines require mobile-friendly responsive sites and cite Title II coverage of mobile apps.
procurement: NJOIT vendor clause: contractor must meet WCAG 2.0 AA per Revised Section 508 for web-based systems and fix reported deficiencies.
enforcement: No state statute or penalty; ADA Title II and NJ Law Against Discrimination (not reviewed).
notes: Bills to amend C.52:18A-234 to make WCAG the statutory standard with CTO certification (S1621/A468 2022; A3636 2024) were found as introduced only; no enactment verified. The NJ hub lists the Title II deadline as 'April 24, 2027', which matches neither the original nor the extended date. Date of the 07-12 clause not shown in the extracted text.
